messages:
maria: Heads-up — Cedarstone usage dropped ~72% after last week's deploy, renewal in 6 weeks. I'm worried about churn.

jake: I saw the spike in errors yesterday too. Their ML lead (Tom) DM'd saying latency/p95 spikes during batch scoring, might be talking to a competitor.

sasha: I'm on a stakeholder call with Tom tomorrow 11am PT. We should have a quick mitigation plan to offer — dedicated trial + monitoring?

maria: Onboarding queue shows 'data sync' stuck and SSO perms flapped. Last CM touchpoint was 5 days ago.

ken: If they're evaluating alternatives we should move fast. Can we offer a short dedicated pool trial (2 wks) with instrumentation? Need commercial signoff.

jake: Technically we can. Short-term fix: prewarm KV cache and bump min replicas to avoid cold starts. I'll draft a deploy snippet.

jake: ```yaml
model: gpt-open-13b
deployment:
  mode: dedicated
  min_replicas: 2
  prewarm: true
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
```

sasha: Nice. Also want a perf benchmark before/after: 1k requests, seq len ~512, capture p50/p95. Can we run that during the trial?

jake: Yes. I'll prepare a repro script. @onboard-bot can you pull usage and latency numbers for the last 30d so we have a baseline?

onboard-bot: Report generated: total_calls=4.3k, unique_users=18, avg_seq=410, median_latency=180ms, p95=1020ms. Link: https://redwood/reports/cedarstone

maria: p95=1020ms explains their complaint. Sasha, during the call offer a 2-week dedicated trial + dashboard access and ask Tom to list success metrics (latency threshold, throughput).

ken: I'll draft a short commercial note and cc finance/legal for the discount approval. Recommend a day-5 checkpoint in the trial to adjust autoscale.

sasha: Plan for tomorrow: present trial, get technical stakeholder list, agree on success metrics, and schedule day-5 checkpoint. Maria — can you draft the follow-up email after the call?

maria: Yep, I'll write it and include the checklist + trial terms.

ken: :thumbsup:

jake: I'll post benchmark results here once the repro completes.

onboard-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 7 days.
